title: 우편환법 시행규칙 / queue:ARTICLE:17:0:00020:part:1/1
full_text:
Article 17 (Request for Delivery of Ordinary Money Order)
(1) The person making the payment may request the relevant post office to deliver the ordinary money order to the recipient. In this case, the person making the payment must indicate this in the ordinary money order payment request form.
(2) The person making the payment who makes a request in accordance with paragraph (1) must pay the fee as determined and announced by the Minister of Science, Information and Communication. (Amended July 31, 1998, March 3, 2008, March 24, 2013, July 26, 2017)
